alerts.headline: Flood Watch issued August 31 at 11:22AM MDT until September 1 at 12:00AM MDT by NWS Grand Junction CO
alerts.description:
* WHAT...Flash flooding caused by excessive rainfall continues to be
possible.

* WHERE...Portions of Colorado, including the following areas,
Central Colorado River Basin, Central Gunnison and Uncompahgre
River Basin, Central Yampa River Basin, Debeque to Silt Corridor,
Flat Tops, Four Corners/Upper Dolores River, Gore and Elk
Mountains/Central Mountain Valleys, Grand Valley, Grand and
Battlement Mesas, Northwest San Juan Mountains, Paradox
Valley/Lower Dolores River, Roan and Tavaputs Plateaus, Southwest
San Juan Mountains, Uncompahgre Plateau and Dallas Divide, Upper
Gunnison River Valley and West Elk and Sawatch Mountains and Utah,
including the following areas, Arches/Grand Flat,
Canyonlands/Natural Bridges, La Sal and Abajo Mountains, Southeast
Utah and Tavaputs Plateau.

* WHEN...Through this evening.

* IMPACTS...Excessive runoff may result in flooding of creeks,
streams, slot canyons, slick rock areas, recent burn scars, and
other low-lying and flood-prone locations. Flooding may occur in
poor drainage and urban areas.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- Monsoonal moisture will remain across the area through this
evening and will support thunderstorms and showers with heavy
rainfall across the watch area. Several rounds of heavier rain
are expected increasing the chance for flash flooding especially
in our more susceptible areas.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood

alerts.title: Paving Operations-144626
alerts.description: Between US 550 and CO 172 (near Durango) from Mile Point 89 to Mile Point 91. Right lane closed due to paving operations. Starting September 1, 2026 at 7:00PM MDT until September 2, 2026 at about 7:00AM MDT. Full schedule below: • September 1, 7:00PM - September 2, 7:00AM Comment: Various eastbound and westbound single lane closures, reduced speed to 40 mph and up to 15-minute delays. For more information email: resurfacingproject@gmail.com.

alerts.title: US 160 Pagosa Springs Reconstruction-139125
alerts.description: Between US 84 and 14th Street (Pagosa Springs) from Mile Point 144.1 to Mile Point 142.8. Road construction. Starting August 31, 2026 at 7:00PM MDT until August 31, 2026 at about 7:01PM MDT. Full schedule below: • August 31, 7:00PM - August 31, 7:01PM Comment: Two-way traffic continues on the north side of US 160. The Lewis Street and US 160 intersection closure remains in place. Please utilize 4th, 5th, 7th, and 8th Streets as an alternative to access businesses along Lewis Street. The good news is that the complex utility line work will be complete by Friday, June 26th. Crews have completed water utility work, wastewater utility work, stormwater, geothermal, gas, and electrical work.

Full schedule below: • September 1, 7:00PM - September 2, 7:00AM Comment: The US 550 - US 160 Grandview Interchange exit and entrance ramps will experience staggered nighttime closures between August 16 and September 4, from 7 p.m. to 7 a.m., Sunday night through Friday morning. Detour: Motorists traveling southbound and northbound on US 550 between Durango and New Mexico will detour on Wilson Gulch Drive and Three Springs Boulevard to access the Grandview Bridge and points beyond.
